label: Claude Fable 5.2
output:
Rick, I'm putting this in writing because I've been stewing since Sunday, and "that's business sis, can't win em all" did not help.

You told Gary I'd list his house for 1%. One percent. I have never said that number to anybody. My listing side is 2.5% and you know it. You made up a "family rate" for a guy who isn't family, and you didn't ask me first.

Then I gave up my whole Saturday for it. I pulled comps, drove down to Chandler from north Phoenix, did the walkthrough, and printed a full listing packet. That's six hours plus the drive. Sunday night Gary texts me he's going with some $3,995 flat fee outfit, no hard feelings. I'm not even that mad at Gary. He was shopping for cheap from the start because you told him cheap was on the table.

I'm mad at you. You get to look like the big shot with the sister in real estate, and I do the work for free. Same thing happened with your softball guy two years ago and I let it go. I shouldn't have, because this morning it's Denise wanting to "pick my brain," and you already gave her my cell.

So from now on, don't give out my number and don't quote my commission. Not 1%, not anything. If somebody you know wants to sell, you ask me first, every single time, and I decide.

I'm not calling Denise. You set that up, so you can tell her.

If it's Mom, or your kids, or anybody who's actually family, I will help any day and advice is free. I've never minded that. What I mind is you volunteering me to your friends like my time costs nothing.

I love you and I'll be at your place for Thanksgiving. I'd just like to get through the turkey without hearing about anybody's house.
